svg.aria-label: A grid of the eight chapters against the sixteen bands and four unreconciled kinds: chapters 1 to 3 in band 1, then one band each for chapters 4 to 6, five for chapter 7 and seven plus four for chapter 8, with band 1 recurring in chapters 4, 6 and 8.
svg.text: names the band as its own
finds it again in its own material
contested: chapter 8 restates part of chapter 6's band-1 finding as band 3
a–d: four kinds named in chapter 8's closing lane, not reconciled into the sixteen
